Missing variables were not inferred. Every distribution format matches its own comma

-separated/JSON content description, including optional third distributions. Main descriptions in this seed carry the variables directly, unlike some distribution-only descriptions in other seeds. Titles, clause order, paragraph layout, length and optional spatial fields vary meaningfully, although many titles and editorial passages remain visibly templated. Repeated distribution content is an explicitly described alternate-format/duplicate export, not a second independent experiment. 9 to 3.91 and its site changes Cedar Reach Central to Silver Creek Upper to Alderbank Lower; publishers also change. These are not identical observational releases.
